text: Figure 3.1: Architecture of a distributed Intrusion Detection System The development of such an IDS can be divided into the following main phases: 1. Security Analysis phase 2. IDS Design phase 3. IDS Deployment phase 4. IDS Operational phase The Security Extract Template supports all these four phases and can both be used for specification and exchange of IDS related definitions by and between OEMs and their suppliers. Therefore, a Security Extract file has potentially a high num- ber of release cycles starting with security analysis and ending with “end of support” for a specific vehicle. emplate
